cs.t: I bought a 43" Sanyo LCD TV (720p) in 2004 that still works today.  It's good enough for movies. I have a 15" Samsung CRT TV from the 90's that still works great.  I use it for retrogaming. > vast majority people buying bleeding-edge OLED TVs (yours truly included) will not use the same TV for 10 years. IMHO people mostly upgrade their TV because a bigger one comes out.  At some point we will reach the maximum practical size for a home TV (kinda like CD drives maxed out at 52x) and then I think people will buy them less.  TVs are already kinda cheap and boring and if they don't keep getting bigger, the average consumer will eventually treat it as a commodity item (and maybe it will be priced that way too).
cs.th: It’s official – LCD TVs won’t see any further development
